annotations.text:
The proposal in one line: a level stops being one plane with a ±t/2 swing on it and becomes THREE named planes — bottom, center, top — one thickness apart, and level L's top is level L+1's bottom.

Switch the three seam models in the panel to see why that last clause is the one that closes the weave.

This sheet is the one to argue with. The plane chips are a FIRST GUESS, not a finding — click any of them to cycle bottom → center → top, and the fold climbs, the crossing gaps and the verdict all recompute.

Tell me the eight rows you actually want and I'll build them into the page.
